title: Two-sided pinching of the H^n-mass of a C^1 graph in small balls
statement: Let n >= 1 and l be natural numbers, R ∈ R, u : R^n → R^l of class C^1 on the open ball B°_R(0) of R^n, x ∈ B°_R(0), and 0 < ε < 1. Let Γ = graphOver u (B°_R(0)) = {(z, u(z)) : z ∈ B°_R(0)} ⊆ R^{n+l} and let B_r((x, u(x))) denote the closed ball (with (x, u(x)) = graphPoint x (u x)). Then there is η > 0 such that for every r with 0 < r <= η, in [0, ∞]: ENNReal.ofReal(((1-ε)^n/(1+ε)^n) omega_n r^n) <= H^n(Γ ∩ B_r((x, u(x)))) <= ENNReal.ofReal(((1+ε)^n/(1-ε)^n) omega_n r^n), where H^n = μHE[n] and omega_n = unitBallVolume n.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (R : ℝ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ η → ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) ^ n / (1 + ε) ^ n * (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) ≤ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ closedBall (graphPoint x (u x)) r) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ closedBall (graphPoint x (u x)) r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) ^ n / (1 - ε) ^ n * (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n))
